title: 🚨 62 Million Pages Stolen from Bulgaria’s Government Documents!
body: 🚨 62 Million Pages Stolen from Bulgaria’s Government Documents!
Bulgaria announced that it stopped a cyber-espionage operation that lasted five years, during which attackers stole more than 62 million pages of government documents — about 130 gigabytes.

The attackers entered government networks in 2021 and were only discovered last August through a new monitoring system; then all their connections were cut, and the systems will remain under tight monitoring for 90 days.
The good news: so far there is no evidence of citizens’ personal data being stolen.
Do you trust governments to protect their documents? What do you think?
